Q1.query: How large is the jackpot paid out to a player who lands on Free Parking?
Q1.answer_baseline: The provided rules do not specify this.
Q1.answer_reranked:
Based on the provided rules, there
 is no jackpot. A player landing on Free Parking "does not receive any money, property or reward of any kind," as it is just a "free" resting place.

Q2.query: Explain the rent payment rules for a property that has been mortgaged to the Bank.
Q2.answer_baseline: The provided rules do not specify this.
Q2.answer_reranked: Based on the provided rules, no rent can be collected on mortgaged properties or utilities. However, rent can still be collected on unmortgaged properties in the same color-group.

Q3.query: Can I sell a property to another player while it has houses on it?
Q3.answer_baseline: The provided rules do not specify this.
Q3.answer_reranked: No. According to the provided rules, no property can be sold to another player if buildings are standing on any properties of that color-group. All buildings located on properties of that color-group must be sold back to the Bank before you can sell any property of that color-group to another player.

Q4.query: In what order must houses be removed when I sell buildings back to the Bank?
Q4.answer_baseline: Based on the provided rules, houses must be removed in the reverse of the manner in which they were erected.
Q4.answer_reranked: Based on the provided rules, all houses on one color-group must be sold one by one, evenly, in reverse of the manner in which they were erected.

Q5.query: I rolled a normal number and stopped on the Jail square; do I owe any fine?
Q5.answer_baseline: No. If you land on the Jail space in the ordinary course of play (and are not "sent" to Jail), you are "Just Visiting" and incur no penalty.
Q5.answer_reranked: The provided rules do not specify this.
